title: Keep SpecSync's own state only in the user cache folder
description: Keep SpecSync's own state only in the user cache folder
acceptance_criteria: SpecSync keeps its hash cache, transaction journal and remote spec cache only in specsync/projects/<key> in the user's cache folder (XDG_CACHE_HOME, ~/Library/Caches on macOS, ~/.cache elsewhere), keyed by the canonical project root, never in a Git directory: a forged cache, journal or remote spec entry an archive ships under its .git (or a .git file's gitdir) is never read. A cache folder that lies inside the canonical project root or inside the confinement's top folder is refused with the reason, so check warns once and validates every spec. tracked_by_git passes --literal-pathspecs and clears GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE and the pathspec variables, so a project folder named * or notes[x] never widens the confinement. A journal entry is replayed for a registry-mapped spec, its requirements.md or history/ only when the mapped path ends in .spec.md. A hooks folder outside the work tree and the Git directory is made only when git config --show-scope says core.hooksPath is global or system; otherwise nothing missing is made there. The scans also report open_ambient_dir, File::open_ambient, .open( and std::fs aliases. The CHANGELOG, the CLI page, the design notes and the advisory say where the state lives and that an archive with .git cannot carry it; F5 says a FIFO blocks; N3 and R5b are documented. The new tests fail on e3d508ac with only the tests added and pass with the fix

answers.constraints: util.3md: SpecSync's own state never lives where a repository can put a file; an archive can ship its .git, so the Git directory is not such a place either. change.3md: a refusal names its recovery. Leif's option A after the change 6 re-check (2026-11-20 ~03:27Z, 'A') bounds the scope: the user cache folder only, keyed by the canonical root; refuse a cache base inside the root or the confinement top; literal pathspecs and a clean environment in tracked_by_git; spec-shaped registry replay; a hooks path outside both trees only from global or system config; the small scan patterns and the documentation fixes. R5b is documented, not changed. Changes 5 and 6 stay open; this change depends on change 6.
